findings.summary: The scrubbed(result.error.message) wrapper is unpinned. It is redundant after the completeSimple scrub at :228.
The ADR-0427 correction note describes the Playground header policy without the 8-char floor. ADR-0479:28, the hint and the CHANGELOG state it.
restoredDraft is set for every status error, including pre-admission refusals (unsupported chat command). Continue then drops the refused command text and sends continue or the attachment alone.
findings.evidence: session.ts:408 throws inside run (status error, no user message_start, so attachments are not cleared at AiChatPanel.tsx:161). The command would be refused again. Image refusal is unaffected (/tmp/pr359-fg4-probe-image-refusal.log).

findings.summary: Sibling of the repaired short-value case: a built-in apiKey has no length floor, so a key like '5' would still mask classifier text.
findings.evidence: builtInApiKeys feeds secrets() unfiltered. ADR-0479 Consequences accepts classification on scrubbed text for declared credentials, and an apiKey is always a real credential.
